name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
benefit: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹10 lakh per unit for eligible individual micro food processing units.
eligibility: Eligible individual micro food processing enterprises
Applicable to eligible new or existing micro food processing units under the scheme guidelines
SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives can also receive support under applicable components
documents: Documents specified by the implementing authority

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
benefit: Margin money subsidy is provided under the scheme for eligible new micro-enterprise projects. The maximum project cost covered for subsidy is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for business/service activities under the revised guidelines.
eligibility: Individual applicants above 18 years of age
Assistance is intended for eligible new projects
Additional educational qualification conditions apply for projects above specified cost thresholds

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: The scheme provides support to eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople through components including skill training, toolkit support, digital transaction incentives and credit support.
eligibility: Eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople working with specified trades
Applicant must satisfy the scheme's age and other eligibility requirements
Eligibility depends on the applicant's occupation and scheme guidelines

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefit: Provides institutional credit support to eligible micro and small business activities through participating lending institutions. Loan products are categorized according to the stage and funding requirement of the enterprise.
eligibility: Eligible micro and small business activities
Applicant must meet the lending institution's requirements
Final loan sanction is subject to lender assessment
documents: Other documents requested by the lender

name: Stand-Up India
benefit: Facilitates bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services or trading, subject to scheme and lending conditions.
eligibility: Enterprise should be a greenfield enterprise
Applicant must satisfy the applicable scheme and bank requirements
documents: Documents required by the lending institution

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
benefit: DAY-NRLM supports rural women through Self Help Groups and livelihood interventions, including support for women-owned and women-governed rural enterprises.
eligibility: Primarily targets rural poor households organized through Self Help Groups and their federations
Specific support depends on the state rural livelihoods mission and applicable programme component
documents: Documents required by the relevant state or programme authority
